title: Brulion Extension API
summary: A small JSON-like capability API for explicitly enabled local JavaScript extensions.

sandbox: no Brulion DOM or CodeMirror access
unsupported: direct DOM, storage, or File System Access access

fields.name: apiVersion
fields.description: Brulion extension API version used by the entry source.

fields.name: entry
fields.description: JavaScript ESM entry file inside the extension directory.

fields.name: permissions
fields.description: Capabilities explicitly granted to the extension.

permissions.description: Publish and remove commands in Brulion's palette and action bar.
permissions.risk: Adds user-invoked actions; it does not grant automatic execution.

permissions.description: Read the active editor and focus it.
permissions.risk: Can read the note currently open in the editor.
Can change the current editor buffer and trigger its normal save behavior.

permissions.description: List and read markdown notes in the granted vault.
permissions.risk: Can read user-owned markdown files in the vault.

permissions.description: Create, modify, remove, and move markdown notes.
permissions.risk: Can change user-owned files; guarded writes prevent silent overwrite.

types.name: ExtensionIconName
types.description: An unconstrained icon name string accepted by command registration; names that are not in the bundled Lucide catalog use the puzzle fallback.

types.name: BrulionCommand
types.description: Metadata shown for a command in the palette and action bar.

types.name: CommandHandler
types.description: A user-invoked command callback. Its return value is ignored.

types.name: RegisterResult
types.description: The host identity assigned to a registered command.

types.name: EditorSelection
types.description: The primary active editor selection, using zero-based document offsets.

types.name: NoteContent
types.description: Note bytes and the mtime used for a subsequent guarded write.

types.name: CreateResult
types.description: Creating a note never replaces an existing file.

types.name: SaveResult
types.description: A guarded note write either saves or reports an external-edit conflict.

types.name: MoveResult
types.description: A note move never replaces an occupied destination.

namespaces.name: commands
namespaces.summary: Register user-invoked commands in Brulion's existing command surfaces.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Adds one namespaced command to the command palette and optional action bar.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Label, stable local id, optional description, and optional icon name string.
constraints: id starts with a lowercase letter
id uses lowercase letters, numbers, -, _, or .
label is non-empty and at most 120 characters
description is optional and at most 240 characters
any non-blank icon string is accepted; unavailable names fall back to puzzle

parameters.name: run
parameters.description: Async or synchronous callback invoked after the user chooses the command.

errors: Rejects if the permission is missing, metadata is invalid, the id is duplicated, or the command limit is reached.
behavior: The returned action id is namespaced as <extension-id>:<command-id>.
The callback runs only after explicit user invocation.
The callback return value is ignored.
Any non-blank icon string crosses the API as metadata; names in the bundled Lucide catalog are rendered and missing or unavailable names use puzzle.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a command previously registered by this extension.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The local command id passed to register().

errors: Rejects if the permission is missing or the id is invalid.
behavior: Unregistering an unknown id is a no-op.
An extension can remove only its own commands.

namespaces.name: editor
namespaces.summary: Read and change the primary selection in the currently open note.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the complete markdown text in the active editor.
errors: Rejects if editor:read is missing or the editor/vault is no longer active.
behavior: Returns the file-format text, including markdown markers hidden by Brulion's visual editor.

methods.name: getSelection
methods.description: Returns the primary editor selection and its text.
errors: Rejects if editor:read is missing or the editor/vault is no longer active.
behavior: from and to are zero-based document offsets.
When there is no selected range, from equals to.

methods.name: replaceSelection
methods.description: Replaces the primary editor selection and returns focus to the editor.
errors: Rejects if editor:write is missing, text is too large, or the editor/vault is no longer active.
behavior: Uses the editor's normal document change and save path.
Does not expose the CodeMirror instance or DOM.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Places keyboard focus in the active editor.
errors: Rejects if editor:read is missing or the editor/vault is no longer active.
behavior: This is a narrow focus action; it does not return a DOM element.

namespaces.name: notes
namespaces.summary: Read and change folder-relative markdown files without exposing filesystem handles.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists every markdown note path in the granted vault.
errors: Rejects if notes:read is missing or the vault cannot be read.
behavior: Paths are folder-relative POSIX paths and include the .md suffix.
The reserved .brulion directory is excluded.
Results are sorted case-insensitively.
methods.example:
const paths = await api.notes.list()
for (const path of paths) console.log(path)

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads one markdown note and returns its content with the current mtime.
errors: Rejects if notes:read is missing, the path is unsafe, or the vault cannot be read.
behavior: A missing note returns { content: "", lastModified: null } instead of throwing.
The normalized path always targets a .md file.
methods.example:
const note = await api.notes.read("Journal/today")
console.log(note.content, note.lastModified)

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an empty markdown note without replacing existing content.

parameters.name: path
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

errors: Rejects if notes:write is missing, the path is unsafe, or the vault cannot be written.
behavior: Creates missing parent folders.
Returns { status: "exists" } and leaves bytes untouched when the destination exists.
methods.example:
const result = await api.notes.create("Journal/today")
if (result.status === "exists") console.log("Already created")

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes complete markdown content with an optimistic external-edit guard.

parameters.name: path
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

parameters.name: expectedLastModified
parameters.description: The mtime returned by the last read or successful write; use null for a create-only write.

errors: Rejects if notes:write is missing, a parameter is invalid, or the vault cannot be written.
behavior: Returns { status: "conflict" } and writes nothing when the on-disk mtime differs.
A null expectedLastModified refuses to replace an existing file.
Creates missing parent folders and preserves the markdown file as the source of truth.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one markdown note if it exists.

parameters.name: path
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

errors: Rejects if notes:write is missing, the path is unsafe, or the vault cannot be written.
behavior: Deleting an already absent note is an idempotent no-op.
The containing folder is not removed automatically.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves one markdown note without overwriting the destination.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Existing folder-relative note name or path.
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: New folder-relative note name or path.
constraints: same safe path rules as read()

errors: Rejects if notes:write is missing, either path is unsafe, or the vault cannot be written.
behavior: Returns { status: "exists" } when the destination is occupied and leaves the source untouched.
Returns { status: "missing" } when the source is absent.
Moves the file bytes without rewriting links or content.
methods.example:
const result = await api.notes.move("inbox/item", "archive/item")
if (result.status === "moved") console.log("Archived")
